note: The skill curves (plan_hl2mp_ai §10): each parameter the brain reads is a value per level 0..10 of one skill. Read by the server through the game's file seam and handed to the AI core as data.

aimErrorDeg.note: the aim's error about the target point once settled: its standard deviation, degrees; it drifts (no new draw per decide) and starts wider at first sight (Hl2mpDecider.AimSettleExtra)

leadQuality.note: the share of the projectile lead the bot aims with (§5.3.3)

glanceRate.note: glances off the path per second while moving and unengaged

preferredRangeScale.note: the weapon family's preferred engagement range is scaled by this

chaseSeconds.note: how long the bot chases an opponent it lost sight of before it searches

coverWeight.note: how much a fighting bot prefers a spot the opponent cannot see

reloadBelowPct.note: the clip share under which the bot reloads when nobody is sighted

searchSeconds.note: how long the bot searches the belief's cells before it gives up

grudgeWeight.note: how much who killed the bot most weighs when it has a choice of opponent

ambushWeight.note: Ambush's utility when an opponent's route is known

routeAltWeight.note: the cost added to the shortest approach's cells, so a cunning bot comes another way

fireRangeGate.note: the bot fires up to this many times the weapon's effective range

pushTrust.note: P(empty) + P(reloading) the push needs (§5.4): 0.6 at 10, 99 (never) at 0

pushMarginSeconds.note: the push's margin: it must arrive this long before the reload ends

strafeWeight.note: the share of a fight's ticks spent strafing

strafeMeanSeconds.note: the mean time between strafe turns (drawn, never periodic)

retreatHealthPct.note: the health share under which the bot retreats from an approaching opponent

rankBonus.note: the target-priority weight of the opponent's scoreboard rank (§5.4)

pathCapMultiplier.note: how much farther than the nearest opponent the bot will walk to its target

easyTargetDiscount.note: the priority a nearer, easier target keeps against the leader

reactionMs.note: after a target is recognised, before the view starts toward it and before the first shot (§3.4.1); ms

trackingLagMs.note: how far behind a moving target the view's pursuit runs, ms

flickOvershootPct.note: how far past or short of the target a flick lands, at most, in percent of its length

prefireChance.note: the chance a bot with a belief fires a burst at the place it thinks someone is, drawn at most once per Hl2mpDecider.PrefireCheckSeconds (§5.4): using a prediction

prefireThrift.note: prefireChance is multiplied by this: a disciplined bot saves its ammo for what it can see (§5.4)

prefireBurstSeconds.note: how long a prefire holds the trigger: a person sprays a corner for under a second, then checks (§5.4)

giveUpHealth.note: below this share of its health, with someone on it, a bot leaves the fight whatever its nerve (the low-Tenacity names: Runs Away, Quitter, Bails Out)

crouchShare.note: the share of a fight at range, holding position, a bot spends crouched while it fires (§5.4, ruling 2026-11-02); Medium's height reads about what the user's recordings show of a person: rarely

recoilControl.note: the share of a climb the view pulls down against while it fires (§3.4.1, recoil 2026-11-02): as far as skill allows, never all of it, and through the view's own lag and turn limits

burstSeconds.note: how long the trigger stays down on a machine gun before letting the climb settle; twice that close, where a body is wide

recoilSettleDeg.note: how far the crosshair has to come back before the next shot or burst: a careless bot fires with it still up

styleNote: A parameter that reads 'style' is read at a skill's height above the bot's own mean (SkillCurves.StyleLevel, §10, ruling 2026-11-02), not its level, so a bot's favourite shows at any difficulty; the rest read the level itself, so difficulty still means skill.
